title: WHAT IF YOU COULD SWITCH OFF SLEEP?

segments.line: Normally, you'd lose the next eight hours. Tonight, they're yours.
You read the book you've ignored since summer.
Then the next one. Then the whole shelf.
Eight hours a night is two thousand nine hundred twenty hours a year.
Four extra months. Every year. That's real.
Even the ones that haven't been assigned yet.
You watch a whole season of a show in one night.
Then you text your friends about it. Nobody answers.
By sunrise, you've done a week of homework, read six books, and you feel… great.
